articles.title: Debunking Common Misconceptions Regarding Self-Funded Health Plans
articles.summary: Industry experts have published an analysis addressing and debunking five widespread myths surrounding self-funded health plans to help employers better understand their risk and cost-management options. This matters because persistent misconceptions often deter mid-sized and regional employers from transitioning away from fully insured models, missing out on potential savings and plan customization. For RxBenefits and self-funded employers, this highlights a critical education gap that advisors must address to drive market adoption and optimize pharmacy benefit strategies.
articles.source_line: Source: The Business Journals; Mon, 17 Aug 2026 06:00:00 GMT

articles.title: New Third-Party Administrator Proposal Aims to Disrupt Health Plan Administration
articles.summary: A new proposal introduces the "Fair Pay, Fair Play TPA" model, designed to fundamentally reshape health plan administration and challenge legacy market structures. This development matters because it targets structural inefficiencies and fee transparency within employer-sponsored health benefits. For self-funded employers and benefit managers, this signals a potential shift toward more competitive, transparent administration options that could alter how health and pharmacy benefits are managed and priced.
articles.source_line: Source: Georgetown University; Mon, 17 Aug 2026 16:44:19 GMT
